notes.title: Game Update (v1.14.02)
notes.content:
[h2][i]New combat items[/i][/h2]
[i]Added a handful of new combat items. These items can be obtained from killing combat NPCs or as loot box rewards.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/3df63823f64f8a11698624ad4bcfd203633e5047.png[/img]

[i]New items are available in the Equipment Shop![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/5bdc28eb2cea7a02a312b86873a4a975bef694fd.png[/img]

[h2][i]Weapon & Shield Item Rebalance[/i][/h2]
[i]All existing weapon and shields were rebalanced. Their tooltips have a new layout which explains where item stat bonuses are coming from.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/61e19990c742270389e479a0016c2d7fa1db752e.png[/img]

[h2][i]Drop Table & Loot Box Rebalance[/i][/h2]
[i]The drop tables were rebalanced for combat NPCs level 1 ~ 17, and the new combat items were added to their drop tables. Loot box reward tables were also updated to add the new combat items.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/7f3164f09acc9f47c56f8e45742fa32753fea582.png[/img]

[h2][i]PVP Zone[/i][/h2]
[i]Players can now enter a level restricted PVP Zone which is restricted so that only character of a certain level can enter. This creates a PVP area which prevents the fear that a high level may enter the PVP Zone and slaughter you. PVP Zones are divided as Lv1~7, Lv8~14, Lv15~21, Lv22~30, Lv30~38.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/bc11d5e1298dc677a39858282541bd0d4dd8a257.png[/img]

[i]The combat NPCs that were spawning in the PVP Zone were moved to these new level restricted PVP Zones. Each PVP Zone will have two combat NPCs, one Paladin and one Sorcerer. As such 2 new combat NPCs were added to PVP Zone Lv1~7. Unfortunately, the PVP Zones of Lv22~30 and Lv30~38 do not have combat NPCs yet. They will be added over the next few updates![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/dcceb1dc1aba8d6d427029046f165b4f5c29057d.png[/img]

[h2][i]Cursed Island & Dybbuk Artifact[/i][/h2]
[i]The rate which Dybbuk Box and Dybbuk Key may drop when killing combat NPCs in the Cursed Island was adjusted. Killing higher level combat NPCs will give a high drop rate! Additionally, the rate which Dybbuk Artifact Fragment may be earned as a reward when completing wave 3 in the Dybbuk Zone was increased greatly![/i]

[h2][i]Egg Hunt Event[/i][/h2]
[i]Decorated Egg drops were increased from 1% chance -> 4% chance until the end of the limited time event! The Egg Hunt event ends July 18.[/i]

notes.title: Game Update (v1.14.01)
notes.content:
[h2][i]Character and Item Art Updates[/i][/h2]
[i]All character artwork and combat item artwork was totally overhauled. Players will now be able to customize their characters with over 270 skins to choose from! A character's skin can be changed at the Vanity Shop for 200 Diamonds. However, the first 3 skin changes are free for every character. Many weapons, armors, wings, and shields were renamed and redesigned to better reflect the game progression.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/6f8a31c6ef99f8088622e605e80859fddb623bcd.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/28f8b3d6d823889ec2fecbb1418c09f4ae6b53da.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/692d89cbf4555f8d895eba75de8185b159ac436e.gif[/img]

[i]Almost all item icons were also updated, finally eliminating those open-source icons that didn't fit the game very well.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/2f8c15950488e28004cd4ce6f73ee41c06bc8c3f.png[/img]

[h2][i]Harvesting and Cooking[/i][/h2]
[i]Those plants that appeared around the game as foliage can now be harvested for resources! Most plants can be harvested without using a tool (just use the action key!), but crops require a shovel to harvest. You can buy a shovel in the Tavern shop.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/b46c97d9141f6635bce1f8dff8b884d84a3b606b.png[/img]

[i]This adds 8 new recovery items with unique healing and buff effects. Most notably, the Sunberry Blossom can cleanse your character of debuffs and negative effects (like DOT or Stun)! These new items can additionally be used in a variety of new cooking recipes, now available at the Chef.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/1062a5b645ef358fe18b7bb578f12dfd9469736e.png[/img]

[h2][i]Crafting and Upgrades[/i][/h2]
[i]When crafting items, players will now have the option to protect their crafting materials by spending Diamonds. The cost to use crafting protection varies depending on the craft.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/8ac77e3211162d57b534efee87378ddcf9ebc537.png[/img]

[i]When upgrading combat items, players will now have the option to craft with 100% success rate by using Holy Relic items at Upgrade Alters. Holy Relic can be obtain by sacrificing a Dybbuk Artifact at the Church in Scepia.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/12f92e9dd5c773158da159927ef9be14cbc116f7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/8b196f4d0c52445795e388074322f3cf3cf7d444.png[/img]

[i]Dybbuk Artifacts can be crafted by combining all 4 Dybbuk Artifact Fragment pieces together at the Crafting Table.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/b16e121ef7366d0f7078bf1da765a23be954d361.png[/img]

[i]Lv22 Wing crafting has been added, which requires Soul Feathers as a crafting ingredient. Soul Feathers are crafted at the Church in Scepia, and also require sacrificing a Dybbuk Artifact to bind its soul to Ancient Feathers.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/48678c46fee376da83505f9dbdbee8e687aca60a.png[/img]

[h2][i]Combat NPC added to PVP Zone[/i][/h2]
[i]Combat NPCs now spawn in the PvP Zone every 3–4 hours, with a chance to drop gear up to Legendary rarity.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/e4b1aeac114404cf7bc38819874e82e618ae77b7.png[/img]

[h2][i]Vanity Items and Shops[/i][/h2]
[i]The Vanity Shop was split into two shops, the Vanity Shop and the Title Shop. They are located in the same area, and they are right next to each other. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/a2a1828846dc79b311e16dbdbce3d8dda1484c3b.png[/img]

[i]In the new Vanity Shop, players will find newly introduced vanity items like sunglasses and eye patches. These vanity items are for cosmetic purpose, and are equipped from the inventory like any other equipable item. Players can also change their character appearance here.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/808498fa1bb2bfb793770cda2e8cdab6ba1de395.png[/img]

[i]This also introduces Signature items, which are like titles but fancier! When a Signature is equipped, a small image will appear between the character and the character name. Some Signatures are even animated! Best of all, they do not override combat items! So players can mix and match vanity items along side their regular combat equipment.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/003b1cc9140732caa2a3402d69fee93041bccd39.png[/img]

[i]A new animal arrived in Scepia, the bunny! It has a very rare chance to drop a new vanity item: Bunny Ears![/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/d5df4a0ccf5f20bd01f84b1455c73ca0ae650c28.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/48bc52e2d7bb6b63417bb0366d9bb63309e6a4d9.png[/img][/url]

[h2][i]Character Adjustments[/i][/h2]
[i]Class names have changed: Holy Knight is now Paladin, and War Mage is now Sorcerer. Unarmed combat was nerfed, and the damage formula was reworked to allow wider min/max variation. Paladin and Sorcerer stats were adjusted to better suit their roles with faster base attacks and more HP per level.[/i]

[h2][i]General Improvements[/i][/h2]
[i]Party size increased to 5, with more EXP per member. Stack limits for potions, food, and tools have been increased. EXP loss on death is now 10%. Loot window stacks items on the same tile. Environmental sounds were added, and several outdated items were removed. Some item values and rarities have been adjusted. Some user interface was also updated.[/i]

[i]You can find the full changelog details on our Discord in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/980251560997179403/980878329525727353/1362595646292365352]changelog[/url] channel.[/i]

notes.title: Game Update (v1.13.10)
notes.content:
[i][b]Cursed Island Revamped...[/b][/i]
The Cursed Island has undergone a complete renewal, featuring a fresh look, new monsters, and exciting mechanics. Players can now enter the Cursed Island as often as they like, with no limits on reentry. A warp portal has been added, allowing players to leave the area early and return to town, though rewards are only granted for full participation. The map now features four difficulty zones, tailored to player levels. These zones scale from level 6 to 35, each with unique monsters and individual scoring systems. A new in-game leaderboard near the warp pillar tracks the top killers for each mini-game session and resets with every event. Party mechanics have also been adjusted: Event Points (EP) are no longer shared among party members, but EXP is split evenly, with an additional 2% bonus per party member. If scores are tied at the end of the mini-game, the player who reached the score first will be declared the winner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/2b0630790ff612717ba6faa66b936f910ec4fbfb.png[/img]

[i][b]Map Updates......[/b][/i]
Several areas of the game have been refreshed. The Chef’s house and the surrounding farm have been updated, complete with more chickens to enhance the environment. A new southeastern area in Scepia has been opened, expanding the map for exploration. Additional details, foliage, and rebalanced monster spawns have been applied across the Scepia map to improve gameplay and immersion. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/30c60cbe2efa431b4256439150a5067e3b680a49.png[/img]

[i][b]New Items and Titles...[/b][/i]
Three new recolor tools—Yellow, Magenta, and Purple—have been introduced, offering players more customization options. Additionally, the Vanity Shop now features 15 new titles, including Procrastinator, Lucky Roller, Accidental Tank, and Death by Tutorial, giving players fresh ways to showcase their achievements and style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/0ed7241834f4eb37e24f7e5df1b8700e7fa6e4c5.png[/img]

[i][b]Item Adjustments...[/b][/i]
Dybbuk Artifacts and recolor tools are now stackable, with a maximum of 30 per stack, making inventory management more efficient. The cooldown time for loot boxes has been reduced from 3 seconds to 0.5 seconds, while a 0.5-second cooldown has been added to loot bags, such as the Bag of Shek. The Shek value of select recolor tools, including Cyan, Pink, and Orange, has been significantly increased to 3,750 Shek.

[i][b]New Quest...[/b][/i]
A new quest, Goblin Notes, has been added, inviting players to uncover more about the world’s lore and mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/f2cae2d99286334a80eb16723b63bc18143ef013.png[/img]

[i][b]Miscellaneous Changes...[/b][/i]
Bonus EXP is now exclusive to mini-games like the Cursed Island, ensuring a more balanced gameplay experience. Various item icons, quest animations, and chatbox log messages have been updated for improved clarity and presentation. Outdated content and data have been permanently removed to streamline the game.

[i][b]Bug Fixes...[/b][/i]
The update resolves several issues, including missing Vanity Shop items such as the Accidental Healer and Merchant titles. All known bugs affecting the Cursed Island mini-game have been fixed, and loot drop inconsistencies, such as missing items from the Rare Loot Box (Lv2), have been corrected.

[i]This update also includes a variety of other tweaks, adjustments, and new content. For the full details, check out the [url=https://discord.com/channels/980251560997179403/980878329525727353/1329616246655811605]changelog[/url] notes in Discord. Gear up and dive in—adventure awaits![/i]

notes.title: Game Update (v1.13.09)
notes.content:
[i][b]More Boss Battles, More Rewards...[/b][/i]
Boss fights just became more accessible! Respawn times for boss monsters have been reduced, meaning you’ll have more opportunities to take on these powerful foes. Even personal boss instances at the Dimensional Portal can now be entered more frequently. To sweeten the deal, boss tokens will drop more often, including from Dimensional Portal bosses!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/9105e5950ae6fbd4b4a35a62db42561e53455b05.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/24dc946c90430dbe3421c4d0ca341172d2817896.png[/img]

[i][b]Renewed Boss Timer System...[/b][/i]
The old boss timer statue was reworked into 4 individual statues representing each boss monster! Players can power up these statues with an Energy Gem to check boss monster respawn times! When powered up, all players in the game can use them. The Energy Gem will power the statues for 4 hours, and then they will be deactivated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/dd186fd2a29145f0e71f28c08d7239ec2ba2bf48.png[/img]

[i][b]Inventory Management Options...[/b][/i]
Make room for all that loot! New bag items are now available in the Boss Shop, allowing you to expand your inventory space from 4 slots up to an incredible 16 bag slots. These upgrades are essential for any serious treasure hunter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/e58567403e311f06e321395e48557a1a82c5f6ee.png[/img]

[i][b]New Titles and Achievement Rewards...[/b][/i]
Over 40 new titles have been introduced, with a handful of them being tied to the brand-new achievement reward system. Earn exclusive titles and items as you hit major milestones in the game. Visit the achievement shop to claim your rewards and showcase your progress like never before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/53ee8a12b7455544827eca55f7a03a9bb26e266e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/0710ac3c7e9f36d68995ee0afe1245057f9657b0.png[/img]

[i][b]Guild Enhancements...[/b][/i]
Guilds have also received exciting updates. Expand your guild bank by purchasing Guild Bank Slot Certificates from the VIP Shop, enjoy slightly longer guild names, and note that creating a guild now requires Shek or Diamonds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/776123abb2083b899d0941d154c139c4f2ecdffb.png[/img]

[i][b]Name Changes...[/b][/i]
Need a fresh start? Players can now change their character names with the new Name Change Certificate, available in the VIP Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/a63e6aa4891b072261c34f7aebf424a6e0b63313.png[/img]

[i]This update also includes a variety of other tweaks, adjustments, and new content. For the full details, check out the [url=https://discord.com/channels/980251560997179403/980878329525727353]changelog[/url] notes in Discord. Gear up and dive in—adventure awaits![/i]

notes.title: Game Update (v1.13.08)
notes.content:
[i]A thrilling new update has arrived in Forgotten Lands Online, bringing significant enhancements to the Dybbuk Zone and the journey toward obtaining Tier 3 wings. Yup, that's right! We are unveiling that Dybbuk Artifacts will be used in a future game update for crafting Tier 3 wings, creating a new level of excitement and exclusivity! Get ready to farm the Cursed Island, as it is the only destination for gathering these rare items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/aefd7faa91fc3299b9edc59e2806a505efa76ff3.png[/img]

In another improvement, the Cursed Island mini-game rewards have been increased, providing greater incentives and ensuring fairer rewards for all who participate. Now, players can confidently join the mini-game anytime, knowing they’ll receive a valuable payout.

Additionally, the quest board has been updated with new bounties targeting the latest monsters, along with a boost to Shek rewards for greater in-game earnings.

Dive into the adventure, and we’ll see you in the world of Forgotten Lands Online! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/20ddf3df35aec139f931f444765a16e34cbbd8e4.png[/img]

[i][b]Dybbuk Zone renewal...[/b][/i]
Updated how the Dybbuk Zone works.
↪ Requires character level 15 to enter.
↪ Players can choose to progress through three waves of fighting.
↪ The Dybbuk monsters that appear fluctuate depending on the player's level.
↪ The Dybbuk monsters' level increases each wave.
The player earns a reward after completing each wave.
↪ Wave 1 reward: Power Gem (60%) or Soul Gem (40%)
↪ Wave 2 reward: Energy Gem (60%) or Creation Gem (40%)
↪ Wave 3 reward: Ancient Feathers x8 ~ x20 (96%) or Dybbuk Artifact (4%)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/91b4a23c595eb3ecd2c35787805d70038ba81826.png[/img]

[i][b]Cursed Island Reward Adjustments...[/b][/i]
Cursed Island Loot Box reward was updated. (silver chest)
↪ Always contains 6 ~ 15 Ancient Feathers.
↪ Contains one random item: Power Gem (30%), Soul Gem (30%), Energy Gem (20%), Creation Gem (20%).
Elegant Loot Box reward was updated. (gold chest)
↪ Always contains 8 ~ 20 Ancient Feathers.
↪ Contains one random item: Power Gem (25%), Soul Gem (25%), Energy Gem (25%), Creation Gem (20%), Vigor Gem (5%).
*The Gold Chest now only gives one loot box, rather than two sperate loot boxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/cd0c570bc96aa7f9f540b2ed69e24f845dcbbbbf.png[/img]

[i][b]Monster adjustments...[/b][/i]
Changed the following monster names:
↪ Spider -> Grass Spider
Added new monsters:
↪ Green Slime (Lv 3, Lv7, and Lv15); drops Green Gels.
↪ Purple Slime (Lv7, and Lv15); can drop Blue Gels / Red Gels.

[i][b]Quest board adjustments...[/b][/i]
Adjusted character level limits for bounty quests.
Adjusted the amount of EXP and Shek rewarded from completing bounty quests.
Increased the monster kill count required to complete some bounty quests.
Added bounty quests for Skeleton Warrior, Skeleton Mage, and Beast monsters.
*At character level 35, players can complete a bounty quest which gives only Shek, until a future update.

[i][b]Added a Tutorial quest...[/b][/i]
Talk to the Tutorial Guide to start the tutorial quest (by the Spawn House, at Scepia 6-4).
The tutorial helps players progress through basic game features, up to character level 12.
Players get the following rewards when completing the tutorial quest:
↪ VIP Loot Box (Lv1)
↪ Title (Official Novice)*
↪ Shek x50,000

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/22bdcb1effe2f6291fc7eff4923ce47e3ebb71b9.png[/img]

[i][b]Map changes...[/b][/i]
Updated the Mossy Grotto map, where Bulls and Great Bulls now spawn.
Added more Drakiid spawns around the Drakiid Cavern entrance.
Adjusted the amount of monster spawns throughout the maps.

[i][b]Gold Monster Lair adjustments...[/b][/i]
The Gold Monster Lairs can only be accessed through the Warp Portal now.
The Gold Monster Lair entrances were removed from the map.
There are multiple floors to the Gold Monster Lair, with more difficult monsters being on the lower floors.

[i][b]Login Reward adjustments...[/b][/i]
The Login Ambassador is now located in Scepia 6-4, inside the house that says 'Login Rewards.'
Characters must now be at least level 5 to start claiming login rewards.
Day 1 login reward was increased from Shek x1,000 -> Shek x5,000.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/45568c0a455c664a843e7e4b36a681bea4138878.png[/img]

[i][b]Item adjustments...[/b][/i]
Phantom Key no longer drops from any monster, and was converted into Diamond Bag (100).
↪ Diamond Bag (100) gives 100 Diamonds when used.
↪ Diamond Bag (100) will be deleted from the game in game version 'v1.14.01.'

[i][b]NPC adjustments...[/b][/i]
Added NPC Dimensional Guide beside the Dimensional Portal, whom provides details about the Dimensional Portal boss instances.
Moved NPC James (whom offers the Gather Eggs quest) to appear inside the Chef's house (before the quest is completed).
NPC Lenardo was replaced by the Tutorial Guide.
Updated the Guard's dialogue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/782f91791c1e883e04195dc19abc008f03d787bd.png[/img]

[i][b]Other game adjustments...[/b][/i]
Increased the character level requirement to enter the Dimensional Portal, from level 6 -> level 8.
Increased the amount of Shek that can be given from opening the Giant Spider Loot Box, from 500 Shek -> 3,000 Shek.
Increased the amount of monster spawns in certain areas.
New characters will now start with a Map of Scepia.
Lowered the cost of the Map of Scepia in the Tavern Shop from 25 Shek -> 10 Shek.
All Title items that are sold to NPC sell for only 1 Shek.
Updated and fixed some user interfaces throughout the game.

[i][b]Bug fixes...[/b][/i]
Fixed bug where killing Sandworm 2 was increasing Sandworm 1 kill counts.
Fixed bug where Cursed Island would declare the wrong player as the winner.
Fixed bug where Hound was dropping Rare Loot Box (Lv1) instead of Rare Loot Box (Lv 2).
Fixed bug with the game music around the Drakiid Den map entrance.
Fixed issue where the game's icon wasn't showing in certain areas throughout Steam (like in the Game Library compact list).

notes.title: Game Update (1.13.07)
notes.content:
Update 13.07 finally introduces boss monster instances! You can enter private boss monster instances, public boss monster get a bit of an adjustment, new monsters were added, and several quality of life updates happened! You'll also be able to participate in the limited time Halloween event to earn exclusive character titles that can only be obtained during the event!


[i][b]Halloween 2024 event![/b][/i]
[i]Event period: Oct 10 ~ Nov 07, 2024[/i]
[i]Added a Halloween event where players can get unique items for a limited time.[/i]
[list]
[*] Pumpkin items will spawn in random areas around the map, for the limited time.
[*] Players can exchange Pumpkin items with Pumpkin Kim for special rewards, for the limited time.
[*] Pumpkin items can alternatively be sold to the NPC for 20 Shek each.
[*] The NPC, shop, and the Pumpkin item will be deleted from the game after the event period has ended.
[*] Other items earned during the event period (excluding the "Pumpkin" item) will remain in the game permanently.
[/list]
[i]*After the event period has ended, this game feature, and the items that can be earned, will no longer be available or obtainable.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/5fab0c5dc1d994cd493d5f523cf11dfb93853e63.png[/img]

[i][b]Boss monster adjustments...[/b][/i]
[i]Boss monster levels and stats were adjusted to fit better with game progression.[/i]
[list]
[*] Zhesad's difficulty increased from Lv 6 -> Lv 8
[*] Drakii's difficulty decreased from Lv 18 -> Lv 15
[*] Krojan's difficulty decreased from Lv 26 -> Lv 22
[*] Moraegisk's difficulty decreased from Lv 34 -> Lv 30
[*] Additionally, all boss monster HP was greatly increased.
[*] Boss monster drops remain the same, except the skill items that can drop have been adjusted accordingly.
[*] Players level 22+ can no longer attack the Zhesad boss monster, in the Spider Cavern map.
[/list]

[i][b]Boss monster private instances...[/b][/i]
[i]Players can now enter a private instance in order to kill a boss monster of their choice.[/i]
[list]
[*] Boss instances can be entered by using the Dimensional Portal in Scepia (4-5).
↪ It requires at least character level 6 to be able to enter.
↪ It costs Shek to enter a private boss area.
↪ Players may only enter one boss instance within a 4 hour period.
[*] There is a time limit to kill the boss.
↪ Players have a total of 30 minutes to kill the boss.
↪ After the 30 minute period, players will be automatically removed from the boss instance.
↪ If the player dies they won't be able to reenter the area, and will permanently lose any items dropped on death.
↪ If the player disconnects from the game, they would remain in the boss instance unless the time limit has already passed.
[*] Boss monsters in private instances have slight adjustments compared to public boss monsters.
↪ The boss monsters in private instances do not have a chance to drop Boss Token.
↪ The boss monsters in private instances do not have HP Regen.
[*] Monsters in the boss monster instance (except for the boss) do not drop any items nor give any EXP.
[*] Players can choose to leave the boss area at anytime through the warp.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/e25f9db94e7ee2cedea45c83e8381203ed033668.png[/img]

[i][b]New monsters added...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Skeleton Warrior (Lv 19)
[*] Skeleton Mage (Lv 21)
[*] Beast (Lv 26)
[*] Unholy Spirit (Lv 27)
[/list]

[i][b]Monsters adjustments...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Ogre difficulty increased from Lv 20 -> Lv 24, and drop table was edited.
[*] Phantom Knight difficulty increased from Lv 28 -> Lv 29, and drop table was edited.
[*] Adjusted some monster skills, and increased the frequency they try to cast skills.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/432638b712f3f490d13463c8c64dce31cefbe66b.png[/img]

[i][b]Map updates and adjustments...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Monster spawn locations around Scepia were slightly adjusted.
[*] Krojan's Tomb map was updated and slightly adjusted.
↪ Boss area was revamped, music changing when fighting the boss was removed, and the outdated 'unlockable' area was removed.
↪ Replaced the monsters that spawn in the map with Skeleton Warrior (Lv 19) and Skeleton Mage (Lv 21).
↪ Skeleton and Lich no longer spawn in the map.
[*] Beast (Lv 26) and Unholy Spirit (Lv 27) spawn in the Corrupt Sepulcher map.
↪ Lich and Great Bull no longer spawn in the map.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/3d0832af72997b59416d503f99f8ba69464d7210.png[/img]

[i][b]Character skill/spell adjustments...[/b][/i]
[i]Adjusted the effects and cooldowns of the following War Mage skills.[/i]
[list]
[*] Lightning: increased the spell cooldown from 10s -> 14s.
[*] Ice Storm: increased the spell cooldown from 10s -> 20s.
[*] Shackle: increased the spell cooldown from 10s -> 14s, and decreased the immobilization duration from 5s -> 3s.
[/list]

[i][b]Merchant shop adjustments...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Increased the cost of some Recolor Tools (Red, Blue, and Green) in the Vanity Shop from 1,000 Shek -> 3,000 Shek.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149950/0f2c63c0ac98014897cebab355282ffc9bac64e3.png[/img]

[i][b]Cursed Island adjustments...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] You'll no longer be kicked from the Cursed Island mini-game if you disconnected from the game.
↪ If the mini-game is still happening, you'll simply remain in the Cursed Island when you log back in.
↪ If the mini-game ended but the reward period is active, you'll be moved to the reward area when you log back in.
↪ If the mini-game and reward period have ended, you'll be removed from the Cursed Island area when you log back in.
[*] The reset time for repeated entries was lowered from 4 entries within 24 hours -> 4 entries within 8 hours.
[*] Added a player counter that shows players how many players have entered the Cursed Island zone.
↪ If a player dies in the Cursed Island, the player count will decrease accordingly. But if a player logs out of the game, it will still show as a player entry.
[*] The chat log now shows your accumulated Event Points when killing monsters in the Cursed Island.
↪ For example "Monsters killed: +10 EXP (+5 EP; Total EP: 25)"
[*] You can now check how many minutes are left until the Cursed Island portal appears by checking the warp pilliar.
[/list]

[i][b]Item adjustments...[/b][/i]
[i]Converted weapon +Speed stat bonus into an +Attack Speed % bonus.[/i]
[list]
[*] Attack Speed % conversion = (100% + (SpeedStatBonus * 0.01))
[*] For example, a weapon that gave 'Speed +800' now gives 'Attack Speed +108%,' approximately.
[/list]


[i][b]Adjusted wing item level requirements...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Tier 1 wings: requires lv 8
[*] Tier 2 wings: requires lv 15
[*] Tier 3 wings: requires lv 22
[/list]

[i][b]New Items...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Beast Carcass
[*] Cooked Beast
[/list]

[i][b]New cooking recipe...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Cooked Beast; costs 34 Shek.
↪ Restores 125 HP + 10 MP.
[/list]

[i][b]Miscellaneous changes...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The game server auto-reboots every day at 11:59 UTC.
[*] Updated the game server time to display as UTC.
[*] Updated the wikis on the website.
[*] Updated the password recovery email to show game branding.
[*] Added game rules to the website, and updated EULA by acknowledging the official Game Rules and requiring agreement to those rules.
[*] The Steam Store download will now be branded as the recommended download source, however the direct download will still be offered as an alternative download option on the website.
[/list]

[i][b]Bug fixes and other minor adjustments...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Updated the map image that shows when using the Map of Scepia item.
[*] Removed the old Recycler NPC from the game, and deleted all remaining Recycler Token items from the game.
[*] Added the "+" symbol on item icons for rarity items that have been upgraded.
[*] Added missing tooltip text for armor items, which shows the item stat bonuses in comparison to the base common item.
[*] Added Phantom Knight and Zhesad to the monster kill count lists when talking to the Guards around Scepia.
[*] You can no longer use the Dybbuk Box while in the Cursed Island map.
[*] Updated the Thunder Staff item icons, and added the glow effect (for rarities) when equipped.
[*] Fixed bug where Thunder Staff wasn't giving Life Steal on the Epic and Legendary rarities.
[*] Fixed bug that prevented War Mage from equipping Demon Wings +8 [Uncommon].
[*] Corrected the fail rate % with Scale Helm [Rare] upgrade.
[*] Removed the text "Can be equipped by all classes" from item tooltips (like shield items).
[*] Fixed the bug where you would get kicked from Cursed Island mini-game with error message "Auto-moved; all players were removed from the Cursed Island mini-game."
[*] Fixed issue where the game would not reboot correctly do to conflict with the script that checks the game server status.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update (v1.13.06)
notes.content:
[i]These are all the game changes that were made since the Steam launch...[/i]

[i][b]PVP Zone...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Added a new map where players can kill each other in player vs. player combat...
[*] You can enter via town warp portal.
[*] There is a small safe area where you cannot do PVP.
[*] If you die from another player, you can drop items on death.
[*] If someone is killed, their items dropped on death can only be seen by the killer until item ownership ends.
[/list]

-----------------

[i][b]Items...[/b][/i]
[i]Items are now upgraded through the 'upgrade alters' located in Scepia (4-5).[/i]
[list]
[*] Weapon, shield, and armor items with rarity can now be upgraded.
[*] ↪ Uncommon items can be upgraded with a Power Gem (from +1 ~ +6) or a Soul Gem (from +7 ~ +9)
[*] ↪ Rare items can now be upgraded with a Power Gem and a Soul Gem, with 100% ~ 70% chance.
[*] ↪ Epic items can now be upgraded with a Vigor Gem, with 100% ~ 65% chance.
[*] ↪ Legendary items can now be upgraded with a Vigor Gem, with 95% ~ 55% chance.
[/list]

[i][b]Shield items stats were adjusted...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Adjusted stats of all shields.
[*] Element Shield and Skull Shield now boost MP rather than HP.
[*] Shields with rarity now give either HP Regen or MP Regen, not both.
[/list]

[i][b]Armor items stats were adjusted...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Adjusted stats of all armor items.
[*] Removed the Magic DEF increase from armor items with rarity.
[*] Bone and Moon items with rarity now give MP bonus rather than HP bonus.
[*] Gloves and Boots with rarity now give Speed bonus rather than HP bonus.
[*] Increased the bonus value for Helm, Armor, and Pants items with rarity.
[/list]

-----------------

[i][b]Crafting...[/b][/i]
[i]You can now craft Vigor Gems...[/i]
[list]
[*] Crafting ingredients: Power Gem + Soul Gem + Energy Gem + Creation Gem + 1,000 Shek.
[*] ↪ 100% Success Rate
[*] ↪ Can be crafted at the Crafting Table in Scepia (4-6).
[/list]

[list]
[*] Wings are now crafted at the Crafting Table in Scepia (4-6).
[/list]

-----------------

[i][b]Merchant Shops...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Updated the items sold in the Boss Shop.
[*] Updated the items sold in the Vanity Shop.
[*] Updated the items sold in the Gold Monster Lair Shop.
[*] Increased the price of Recolor Tool (Cyan), Recolor Tool (Orange), and Recolor Tool (Pink).
[/list]

-----------------

[i][b]Login rewards...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Changed the Day 7 login reward from Uncommon Loot Box (Lv1) -> Diamonds x100
[/list]

-----------------

[i][b]Website updates...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Added a VIP Webshop to the website.
[*] Updated the wikis.
[/list]

-----------------

[i][b]Other adjustments...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Adjusted some item values.
[*] Updated item tooltip text descriptions.
[*] Slightly changed the color given by the Recolor Tool (Blue) so its more legible.
[*] The monsters in Gold Monster Lair no longer give EXP (except for the boss).
[/list]

-----------------

[i][b]Bug fixes...[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed several user interface issues.
[*] Fixed some areas of map such as collisions or graphics.
[*] Fixed issues where players were able to attack other players outside of the PVP Zone.
[*] Corrected some item stats that were bugged.
[*] Corrected issue that prevented the Moraegisk boss from dropping the Thunder Staff.
[/list]

-----------------
